listing.name: Coherent Watermelon's Ship Pack (CWSP)
listing.summary: Adds a collection of vanilla-style ships including fighters, anti-fighter units, and Anti-Phase ships.

description:
A ship pack with a kinda vanilla style aim that i've been working on for a while now. has a lot of fighters, things to deal with fighters, and the ever-beloved Anti-Phase ships!

Download

0.95 update! i also added a bunch of things. i'll update the thread with a more workable full photo of everything included again soon. just a mild mess right now in that regard

The best and most immediate way to contact me would likely be by way of the Starsector Unofficial Discord. If you can't get to there, i'll try to occasionally check the forums so i'll eventually read it anyways.

Current goals:

- make better sounds

- make more ships

- refine this page

-

fix bugs (important)
